title: Pre-AC1018 paper-space layout ownership cross-peer crosswalk
mode: Primary-source peer issue/source review plus local reader and test-owner audit; plan-only
scope: Review ACadRust's AC1015 multi-layout ownership report and determine whether its status establishes current peer behavior.
Crosswalk the legacy first/last entity-chain route to libdxfrw's pre-AC1018 reader path and existing generated test owners.
Refresh evidence boundaries for broad version matrices, same-codec SAB controls, and correlated downstream applications.
Refine the existing PAR-49/7G.3 plan with a fast, scratch-generated layout ownership regression.

sources.revision: Issue page reviewed 2026-10-19; the issue reports acadrust 0.6.3 and main at f18646a for the reproduced state.
sources.observed: The report describes an AC1015 DWG where entity-mode 1 paper-space entities from non-active layouts are assigned to the active layout because the reader discards BLOCK_HEADER first/last entity handles. Its AC1032 control preserves layout membership. The issue was closed against commit 8346596, but the linked commit is under a contributor fork and the issue text says upstream merge is pending.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer-reported behavior and fix proposal only. Current upstream integration and release behavior were not established; this does not demonstrate a libdxfrw defect. No peer artifact was downloaded or run.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw reader and test owners
sources.revision: Shared worktree at de27a33 with extensive uncommitted changes; read-only source/test inspection on 2026-10-19.
sources.observed: The pre-AC1018 branch in readDwgBlocks walks a block's firstEH through nextEntLink until lastEH. DRW_Block_Record retains firstEH/lastEH. Inspected tests cover related block ownership and DXF layout serialization, but no focused generated AC1015 DWG reader test asserting multiple paper-space layout memberships was located.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Static source and test-owner review only; no parser, build, or test execution. Absence is a bounded test-inventory observation, not proof no equivalent coverage exists elsewhere.

sources.revision: Mutable project documentation and issue index reviewed 2026-10-19.
sources.observed: LibreDWG documents stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled class dispositions. ACadSharp lists DWG/DXF reader and writer support separately by version; its current issue index contains route- and field-specific reports despite the broad version matrix.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project self-description and issue reports only. They do not define a comparable coverage denominator or establish a local behavior.

sources.project: ACadRust current feature/test disclosures and downstream route lineage
sources.revision: Mutable project pages and test source reviewed 2026-10-19.
sources.observed: ACadRust advertises broad DWG/DXF versions, entity families, and ACIS/B-rep functionality. Its visible AcDs tests fabricate marker-bearing SAB payloads and exercise the same implementation's write/read path. CADCraft and OpenCADStudio use ACadRust; uncad routes DWG through LibreDWG FFI and DXF through undxf.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Self-described support and same-codec regression evidence only. This is not independent SAB validity, B-rep semantics, native acceptance, or an additional independent DWG-reader vote.

sources.revision: The repository's required local PDF path was checked during this pass but the file was unavailable in the execution environment.
sources.observed: No ODA section was used to make a new normative claim in this research update.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Before any parseDwg/readDwgBlocks production change, read the applicable ODA v5.4.1 legacy BLOCK_RECORD and entity-chain sections as required by AGENTS.md.

existingOwnersRefined: peer route identity and support-disposition matrix
assessment.planImpact: Refine existing PAR-49/7G.3 with one in-memory/scratch-generated AC1015 multiple-layout reader regression, paired with an AC1018+ owner-handle control. The peer report is not a local defect or current-release fix result. Preserve exact layout/block/entity identity, avoid external fixtures and new CTest registration, and do not change support claims or the top-level execution order.

implementationReadiness: Before changing DWG parser code, read the relevant ODA v5.4.1 legacy BLOCK_RECORD and entity-chain sections; the specified local PDF was unavailable during this research pass.
Use the existing libdxfrw_dwg_reader_matrix_tests target/CTest and a focused selector; generate AC1015 first/last/next-entity chains without committing a peer or customer DWG.
Assert layout-name-to-block-record mapping, exact per-layout child handles/types and order, empty/default layout behavior, first==last singleton handling, and a following-object sentinel.
Generate the same logical manifest for AC1018+ explicit owner handles and compare normalized ownership rather than cross-version bytes.
Add bounded cycle and missing-middle mutations only where the existing reader's documented failure/softening policy can be asserted without rehoming records.
Use strict touched-target build, focused selector, owning CTest, scoped diff check, and receipt validation; then continue the next local ready item without waiting for external peer/native access.

method.kind: Primary-source web research plus local read-only source/test crosswalk
method.limitations: ACadRust issue #121's closed state does not resolve whether the cited contributor commit is in a released upstream artifact. Peer capability/test statements remain self-reported. No local DWG sample was available or created. The prescribed local ODA PDF was unavailable, so no normative wire-layout change is proposed.
